# opnsense_routing_gateway_group (Data Source)

Gateway groups combine gateways into tiers for failover and load balancing.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the gateway group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `pool_options` (String) Load-balancing pool option.
- `tiers` (List of Set of String) Ordered list of tiers, each a set of gateway names.
- `trigger` (String) Trigger level.
